title: The Monster Manual of Styleguides — Bestiary Volume I

root.summary: Design techniques, deconstructed from the wild and rebuilt as real std-doc primitives. Each page shows the creature alive — the actual primitive, rendered — and the one line that summons it. We learn the grammar; we never wear the costume. Stripe needs the Stripe design and nobody else.

facets.What you see: the real, shipped primitive — not a picture of one
facets.What you get: one line of JSON to use it in any doc
facets.The law: steal the technique, never the costume

nodes.title: The Bestiary
nodes.tagline: every creature below is a real primitive — the picture IS the dish

blocks.text: Each page shows one design move, rendered live by the std-doc primitive that makes it real — and the single line of JSON that summons it.
blocks.sub: We read the grammar of great design once, then write our own sentences. Rhyming with someone famous is the opposite of the mission: std-doc exists to give our kind their own hands.

nodes.title: The Surface Ladder
nodes.tagline: depth by tone — not a single shadow

blocks.body: There is no shadow in this box — the lift is pure tone, a lighter surface against a darker one. Reach for it when a card should feel raised without the weight of a drop shadow.

nodes.title: The Hairline
nodes.tagline: a border that lifts instead of cages

blocks.lead: The edge belongs to the surface.
blocks.body: A 1px border tuned to the surface's own family, one notch darker — so the box reads as lifted, not outlined. Never a hard grey ink line drawn around the content.

nodes.title: The Edge-Light
nodes.tagline: a hairline of light along the top edge

blocks.body: A 1px highlight along the upper border — the panel catches the light like a bevel. Strongest on a dark style. Keep the alpha tiny or it turns to gloss.

nodes.title: The Tinted Shadow
nodes.tagline: elevation colored by the brand, not by black

blocks.body: When a shadow IS warranted, tint it with the accent instead of neutral black — the depth reads as part of the palette, like elements floating in a colored twilight rather than punched out of the page.

nodes.title: The Gradient Wash
nodes.tagline: atmosphere from a slow color transition — no image

blocks.sub: Two near-neighbours of the accent, washing one direction, low and quiet. A gradient should whisper — the moment it spans the color wheel it screams crypto landing page.

nodes.title: The Mono Texture
nodes.tagline: monospace as an eyebrow — engineered, not editorial
